notes.title: November Update
notes.content: Our monthly update is now released! In addition to 5 new levels is the much requested feature allowing both corner and center notes in the same cell. You can turn this feature on in the Gameplay Settings under "Double Notation."

notes.title: October Update
notes.content: We've released 5 new puzzles in our October monthly update. Enjoy!

notes.title: New levels coming Sept 16th
notes.content:
We will be releasing the first batch of 5 new levels on the 16th! There will be puzzles for players of all skill levels, including a truly difficult 10 star puzzle that will require completing the first 44 levels to unlock. We've also released a number of fixes and quality of life updates. Check out the update log on the forums for more information on what's new.
